productDefects.fixIdea: Give the existing End early panel modal semantics and shared focus/escape/return behavior while preserving its existing visual classes. Focus Keep going; Escape cancels only the confirmation; restore focus to End early.

Route the photo viewer through the existing feature-detected Modal/fallback primitive, preserving the image and panel appearance. Do not call showModal/close on missing methods; prevent Notebook mount or View photo from escalating to whole-app recovery.

limits: Actual app, real AppProvider/repository/UI handlers in Chromium on saved Linux cloud executor. Only synthetic records and dialog-method absence are injected.
No native keyboard/device or unsupported real-device claims. All requests outside the local preview are blocked. No providers, payments, secrets, app edits or deployment.
